blocks.html: At the end of the said nine years she was unbewitched, and to this end instructed to have four masses said, which she did; and she names the priests, and [says] that one of them (whom she set down by name) made her eat some hosts and fouaces [hearth cakes], from which she and her said husband found themselves so well that she conceived, immediately afterwards, a son, still living, called Sanxi Guerre.
